name: gymolingo
description: Gymolingo – Gym, Nutrition & AI Progress App (Expo + Supabase monorepo)

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gymolingo/core && npm run typecheck -w mobile
scripts.build:web: cd apps/mobile && expo export --platform web --output-dir dist --clear
scripts.build:web:test: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_TOOLS=true expo export --platform web --output-dir dist --clear
